categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in three integrated business segments: electronic products, R&D services and solutions, and high-level intelligent driving overall solutions. Its electronic products cover intelligent assisted driving, intelligent cockpit, intelligent networking, body and comfort domain, chassis control, and new energy and power systems. The R&D services focus on vehicle electronic and electrical development and testing, middleware, and proprietary toolchains. The intelligent driving solutions include autonomous driving vehicles, cloud control platforms, and digital twin systems for logistics and port operations.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include advanced driver assistance systems (ADAS), millimeter-wave radar, conditional automated driving, high-performance computing platforms (HPC), augmented reality head-up displays (AR-HUD), chassis control systems, telematics control units (T-BOX), and full-stack battery management systems (BMS). The company employs model-based V-development processes, heterogeneous SoC computing platforms, and software architectures like SOA and AUTOSAR. It also develops proprietary software tools for simulation, testing, and AI-assisted development, supporting full lifecycle vehicle electronic system development and validation.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are major domestic and international OEMs and Tier 1 suppliers in the automotive industry, including brands like Geely, BYD, NIO, Changan, and international clients such as Stellantis, Scania, and BorgWarner. The company serves passenger vehicles, commercial vehicles, and special autonomous transport vehicles, with products applied in intelligent driving, smart cockpits, and new energy vehicles. It also targets port logistics and autonomous transport markets with its high-level intelligent driving solutions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with significant presence in key regions including Beijing, Tianjin, Jiangsu, Shanghai, and overseas locations such as the United States, Germany, Malaysia, and Hong Kong. It has established R&D centers and production facilities in these regions to support global OEMs and Tier 1 suppliers. Its products comply with international standards and are supplied to global markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the automotive electronics supply chain. It develops, manufactures, and supplies electronic control units, sensors, and software solutions directly to OEMs and Tier 1 suppliers. It also provides R&D services and integrated intelligent driving solutions, positioning itself as a comprehensive technology and system supplier within the automotive electronics ecosystem.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include advancing intelligent driving technologies, expanding domain controller product lines, enhancing AI integration in R&D tools, and accelerating commercialization of L4 autonomous driving solutions. The company emphasizes software-defined vehicle architectures, domain fusion electronics, and high-performance computing platforms. It also focuses on international market expansion, supply chain optimization, and talent development to sustain innovation and competitive advantage.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of automotive electronic components and systems, including intelligent driving modules, smart cockpit devices, and battery management systems. Additional revenue streams come from R&D service contracts, software licensing, and integrated intelligent driving solutions for logistics and port operations. The company also benefits from government subsidies and investment income related to financial assets.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic player in automotive electronics and intelligent driving, competing with both local and international suppliers. It holds top ten market shares in products like front-view systems, body domain controllers, and AR-HUDs in China. Its self-developed ADAS systems break international monopolies, and it maintains competitive advantages through high R&D investment, full-stack software capabilities, and early adoption of domain fusion architectures.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 5.54 billion, an 18.46% increase year-over-year, driven by rapid growth in electronic product sales. Despite revenue growth, net profit attributable to shareholders was negative RMB 550 million due to increased costs and high R&D expenses. The company has total assets of about RMB 9.4 billion and employs over 7,300 staff, with a strong focus on R&D personnel. It continues to invest heavily in innovation and capacity expansion, indicating a growth-oriented trajectory.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its integrated 'three-in-one' business model combining electronic products, R&D services, and intelligent driving solutions to offer comprehensive lifecycle support. It differentiates through proprietary core technologies, full-stack software and hardware development, and advanced AI-enabled tools. Its products meet stringent safety and regulatory standards, support multiple vehicle platforms, and provide scalable solutions from L2+ to L4 autonomous driving. The company also highlights its strong talent base, international presence, and ability to deliver customized, high-quality automotive electronics and intelligent transport solutions.
